M-SERVICE-TELEMETRY.Summary: (ENTRY_POINT) Joins the GT7 UDP broadcast, decrypts Salsa20 packets and exposes live vehicle state plus a heartbeat.

M-SERVICE-UDP.Summary: (INTEGRATION) Socket binding, packet reception and local address discovery for the telemetry listener.

M-MODEL-TELEMETRY.Summary: (DATA_LAYER) Decoded telemetry values: speed, RPM, gears, tyres, fuel, lap and throttle/brake traces.

M-MODEL-TRACK-TRACE.Summary: (DATA_LAYER) Records positions from telemetry packets so the HUD can draw a track map.

M-WIDGET-TELEMETRY.Summary: (UI_COMPONENT) Telemetry presentation: HUD layout, gauges, tyre panel, throttle/brake graph, motion workspace, 3D car and track map.

M-BLOC-THROTTLE-BRAKE.Summary: (CORE_LOGIC) Windowed throttle/brake/clutch history for the graph widget.

M-SERVICE-DG-EDGE.Summary: (INTEGRATION) Scrapes dg-edge daily race cards and detail pages with a fixed timeout and crawl delay.

M-SERVICE-GTSH-RANK.Summary: (INTEGRATION) Scrapes gt-sh ranking cards, including leader and slipstream data.

M-REPO-SPORT.Summary: (DATA_LAYER) Merges both daily-race sources on the game's own board id, tolerates one source failing, and orders future before current before past.

M-MODEL-DAILY.Summary: (DATA_LAYER) Unified daily race plus the per-source models it is built from.

M-WIDGET-DAILY.Summary: (UI_COMPONENT) Daily races screen: cards, detail sheet and the field histogram, with skeletons while loading.

M-SERVICE-GT7INFO.Summary: (INTEGRATION) Reads the gt7info used/legendary car lists and their price history.

M-SERVICE-GTDB.Summary: (INTEGRATION) GraphQL client for the community car database, including AVIF artwork identifiers.

M-REPO-CAR.Summary: (DATA_LAYER) Merges gt7info and GTDB cars, owns the used/legendary split and the refresh flags.

M-MODEL-CAR.Summary: (DATA_LAYER) Car record with its derived presentation: status text, price formatting, region flag and image URL priority.

M-WIDGET-CAR-DEALER.Summary: (UI_COMPONENT) Used and legendary dealership screens and their car cards.

M-MODEL-GT-AUTO.Summary: (DATA_LAYER) Static catalogue of GT Auto counters with their icons and multipliers.

M-WIDGET-GT-AUTO.Summary: (UI_COMPONENT) GT Auto screen: counter tiles and the counter detail view.

M-SERVICE-GT7-AUTH.Summary: (INTEGRATION) PSN login flow: in-app WebView session, token exchange, persistence and platform-specific cookie clearing.

M-SERVICE-GT7-API.Summary: (INTEGRATION) Official GT7 API calls with one retry after a token refresh, returning null instead of throwing.

M-SERVICE-NETWORK-SCANNER.Summary: (INTEGRATION) Finds a PlayStation on the local network for Remote Play setup.

M-REPO-GT7-AUTH.Summary: (DATA_LAYER) Bridge between the auth service, the API service and the UI-facing login state.

M-REPO-TRACK.Summary: (DATA_LAYER) Course catalogue plus the recorded lap trace, so a circuit name can be attached to a measured lap.

M-PAGE-LOGIN.Summary: (UI_COMPONENT) PSN sign-in screen: WebView orchestration, progress reporting and the result it returns to the profile page.

M-PAGE-WISHLIST.Summary: (UI_COMPONENT) Wishlist screen for cars the player is tracking.

M-SHELL-HOME.Summary: (UI_COMPONENT) Home hub: telemetry panel, daily races section and the grid of service tiles.

M-SHELL-TABS.Summary: (UI_COMPONENT) Bottom tab shell (home, wishlist, profile, telemetry) built on AutoTabsRouter.

M-NAVBAR.Summary: (UI_COMPONENT) Responsive navigation bar that switches tabs and falls back to a route pop when tabs are unavailable.

M-DI-APPSCOPE.Summary: (UTILITY) The single provider registration point for services, repositories and blocs.

M-ROUTER.Summary: (UTILITY) auto_route configuration: nested tab shell plus the vertical screens.

M-THEME.Summary: (UTILITY) Dark-only GT7 theme: colour scheme, full text theme, one ThemeExtension and the gt7* helpers telemetry uses.

M-SOUND.Summary: (UTILITY) The audio layer, in two channels: interface sounds (the effect catalogue, the player seam behind which the engine sits, the service owning preference, volume and debounce, the route observer that sounds pages and popups alike, and one root interceptor that makes the press sound automatic across every surface by telling a tap from a drag) and ambient music (a looping rotation of shipped tracks with its own preference, fades, and a pause whenever the app leaves the foreground); effect levels and channel volumes are derived from measured file loudness rather than chosen by ear.

M-FEATURE-PROFILE.Summary: (CORE_LOGIC) Player profile loading through BLoC over the auth repository, including stats history models.
